author: Ban.Anna

title: Nice app + suggestion
body:
Well, this is a great app to form new good habits and stop doing the bad ones. 
Here is my suggestion:
Since we use the app for habits, it would be nice to have a countdown (example: 45 days left) to know when that thing became a habit.

 “On average, it takes more than 2 months before a new behavior becomes automatic — 66 days to be exact”

I hope you understand the suggestion and take it in consideration.

Keep up the good work!
